properties.description:
The `revision` block a write returns now carries `prior_state_preserved_in` — the Snapshot holding the replaced state — and says one of two DIFFERENT things depending on what the graph actually holds.

THE DEFECT IT CLOSES. That block already said '`record_change` BEFORE the merge is what puts the old state in the design's own timeline' — UNCONDITIONALLY, in identical words, to a caller who had just done exactly that and to one who had destroyed something. Advice that never varies is advice a reader learns to skim, and the one time it mattered looked like all the times it did not. That is the catalogue problem in miniature, inside the very mechanism `req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue` names as the one that works.

COMPUTE THE OUTCOME, DO NOT TRACK THE INVOCATION — the requirement's stronger form, and the reason this survives an agent that ignores every hint: it reads graph state, not run history. dev_storyflow's dragon Boss proposed the identical shape independently ('report whether the target has a snapshot — NOT BLOCK, JUST SAY'), which is two consumers arriving at one design from opposite ends.

MATCHED BY CONTENT HASH, NOT BY EPOCH. 'At the current epoch' needs a notion of CURRENT that reflow2 does not have, and it answers a weaker question. The hash answers the one a caller actually has — is what I just replaced recoverable? — and it makes a stale snapshot of a DIFFERENT state correctly NOT count as preservation. Verified 2026-08-18 that a Snapshot's stored `state` hashes to exactly the `prior_content_hash` a revision reports.

NOTHING BLOCKS. A tool that blocks becomes a tool people route around, and then the graph stops matching reality — the one failure it cannot survive. Every probe asserts the write landed.

HONEST COST: `snapshot_preserving` scans every Snapshot, so it is O(snapshots) per revising write. At 144 that is nothing; at a hundred thousand it would need an index on `target_id`.
properties.name: A revising write computes whether the state it replaced is preserved, instead of restating the rule at everyone
